text: On the eighteenth of June, twenty twenty-three, Titan began its dive toward the Titanic. It starts from a floating platform, then sinks slowly, for about two hours, down to the wreck. About an hour and forty-five minutes in, communication stopped. Investigators believe the hull gave way, and the ocean crushed it inward. An implosion like that is over in a few milliseconds. Far faster than anyone on board could have noticed. For four days, the world searched. Then a robot found the pieces on the sea floor, about five hundred metres from the Titanic's bow.
